headline: HOU @ KCR matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is HOU 4.89 at KCR 4.37, with a projected total of 9.26. Movement read: Both offenses moved up (HOU +0.25, KCR +0.23), so the movement is more about a higher-scoring game environment than a stronger side. The projected total climbed +0.48, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Stephen Kolek has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Vinnie Pasquantino, Yordan Alvarez, Bobby Witt Jr., based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Joey Loperfido, Tyler Tolbert because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
